snapshot_rule: Fixed-window science scores reflect the role and current-window achievement actually active in the window. A historic field-defining discovery is retained in lifetime peak but is not automatically inherited as a later snapshot score 4. Active world-leading research generally maps to 3 unless a current-window field-defining/apex achievement is directly supported.
